title: Level 1 (Beginner) - B-15
notes:
West leads the ♥10 against 6NT. After the defense takes the ♥A and continues hearts, South must play the club suit for no losers.

There is only one distribution of the defenders' clubs and only one play in that suit that will allow clubs to be picked up without loss. South must play East to have a singleton ♣J. He must play the suit by leading the ♣Q.

If the hoped for distribution exists, the defense has no counter. If West plays low, dummy plays low, and East's ♣J is pinned. South still has a finessing position over the ♣K. If West covers the ♣Q with the ♣K, the ♣A is won as East follows with the ♣J. South now has a finessing position over West's ♣9.
